name: Pacific Plaza
summary: Pacific Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center in La Jolla, San Diego, offering convenient retail and service options to the local community and coastal visitors. Managed by La Jolla Management, the center maintains a strong reputation with a 4.3-star rating and provides leasing opportunities in a prime coastal location.
demographics: Pacific Plaza serves the affluent La Jolla community, attracting primarily upper-middle to high-income residents and visitors with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws a mix of local professionals, families, and tourists visiting the nearby beaches and University of California San Diego campus. Shoppers tend to be educated, health-conscious consumers aged 30-65 who value convenience and quality, with strong preferences for specialty retail, dining, and service-oriented businesses in a walkable neighborhood setting.
description: Pacific Plaza is a well-established neighborhood shopping center located in the heart of San Diego's prestigious La Jolla community at 1702 Garnet Avenue. Managed by La Jolla Management, this open-air retail destination has served the local community for decades, offering convenient access to a variety of shops and services. The center's prime location near Pacific Beach provides excellent visibility and accessibility for both residents and the steady stream of visitors drawn to San Diego's beautiful coastal areas. With a strong 4.3-star rating from over 1,400 reviews, Pacific Plaza has built a reputation as a reliable community gathering place. The property features available commercial retail spaces for lease, making it an attractive opportunity for businesses looking to establish themselves in one of San Diego's most desirable neighborhoods.
